model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the "effect" across various language families for six different model configurations. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "family," and displays nine discrete language families arranged alphabetically: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "effect," using a linear scale with a visible range from slightly below zero to approximately 35 to accommodate error bars. Numeric tick labels are provided at intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30), with corresponding horizontal grid lines spanning the chart. The chart features grouped bars, where each language family category contains a cluster of six adjacent bars. According to the legend, these bars represent different configurations, distinguished by color: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). All bars are outlined in black and feature black, capped error bars indicating variability. The heights of the bars vary significantly across the categories. The tallest bars are found in the IE-Indic group, where mBERT-B₂ reaches approximately 24, XLM-B₂ is about 21, and mBERT-R₂ is roughly 20. Conversely, the shortest bars, representing values near zero, are seen in the Isolate and Uralic categories across multiple configurations, such as Isolate mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂. Some bars extend below the zero line into negative values, most notably in the Semitic category, where mBERT-R₂ is approximately -2.5 and XLM-R₂ is roughly -1. The categories are sorted alphabetically along the horizontal axis, and the bars within each group consistently follow the order presented in the legend.
